Eleni P.: quick Q 401  I'm traveling to BR next week for a customer kickoff and their entry rules require a negative PCR within 72h. Does Redwood reimburse COVID test fees?
Ravi (People Ops): short answer: yes, but only when the test is a mandatory entry/exit requirement or employer-mandated for the trip. voluntary tests for personal peace-of-mind are not reimbursed.
Eleni P.: ok good. i assume i should get preapproval? i already booked travel.
Ravi (People Ops): if the test is required by the destination/airline or by a customer, you do not need preapproval but you must attach the official travel requirement (link or screenshot) when you submit the expense plus the itemized test receipt. if it's a company-requested test (e.g., for an in-person event), get manager approval or people-ops preapproval before booking.
Marta (manager): @Eleni P. this kickoff is customer-facing and we require the test for entry. i approve reimbursement. 
Eleni P.: what receipts do i need exactly? PCR lab receipt vs pharmacy receipt? digital proof is fine?
Ravi (People Ops): we need an itemized receipt showing: provider name, test type (PCR/NAAT/antigen), date, and amount paid. A PDF or emailed invoice is fine. Screenshots of credit-card-only chargers without provider details are not acceptable. If you paid cash, get a signed receipt from the provider.
FinanceBot: finance note: include the payment method and currency. For non-US vendors include exchange rate info or the credit card statement showing charge in USD. If a single vendor is paid >$600 in a year, additional vendor paperwork may be requested.
Eleni P.: any cap per test? my PCR was $120 at a private lab.
Ravi (People Ops): we don't have a strict cap for mandated tests, but reviewers check reasonableness. $120 is in range for private PCRs in many markets. If cost looks unusually high we may ask for alternative quotes (e.g., airport clinic or public testing center).
Eleni P.: if i fail the test and need a follow-up test or medical visit, is that covered?
Ravi (People Ops): diagnostic tests required to meet entry/return rules are reimbursable. Medical treatment is handled separately under healthcare benefits; please contact benefits@redwood.com for guidance and keep receipts.
Eleni P.: timeline for expense submission? i want to submit quickly.
Ravi (People Ops): file within 30 days of travel. Use expense category "Travel - Mandatory Health Test" and attach the required docs (travel rule screenshot, itemized receipt, manager approval).
Marta (manager): thanks. @Eleni P. go ahead and submit, i've approved.
Eleni P.: thanks all  saving my nerves here :)
